$comment: Data for scripts/boundary-lint.mjs: backend names the core (apps/, packages/, testing/) must never spell, and cross-repo packages/paths it must never import. A $GUNNFLOW_HOME/boundary-names.local.json (default ~/.gunnflow/) is merged when present and BOUNDARY_NAMES_FILE is not set. The lint code itself names no backend.

simulatorDoors.$comment: The one place app runtime source may name the simulator: the BFF composition loads it dynamically, in fake mode only.

domainVocabulary.$comment: The simulator's domain words must not steer the engine: kinds, actions and states are the backend's, read through wiring. Tests, the i18n catalogs, the built-in default wiring and the simulator (testing/, not scanned) are exempt. Existing hits are frozen in boundary-baseline.json.

patterns.name: dotted domain action in a string (not a t('…') catalog key)
kind compared to a domain word
domain word compared to a kind
